title: FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) overview
text: Suspicious activity reporting involves documenting activity that may warrant review and describing supporting facts. This is a project-authored summary, not a quotation or legal threshold. An analyst must assess applicability before filing.

title: FinCEN Bank Secrecy Act overview
text: The Bank Secrecy Act establishes recordkeeping and reporting obligations for covered financial institutions. This project-authored summary is informational, not legal advice.

title: FinCEN Structuring information
text: Structuring concerns patterns of transactions designed to evade applicable reporting requirements. Repeated transfers alone do not establish intent; contextual investigation is required. Project-authored summary, not a verbatim regulatory passage.

title: FINRA Anti-Money Laundering
text: FINRA describes anti-money laundering program expectations for covered member firms, including monitoring and escalation. Applicability depends on the institution. Project-authored summary, not a verbatim regulatory passage.
